about_the_game:
Introduction

First Age is a card based strategy game set in the neolithic era in which you build up humanity’s first civilization, through this turn based system you will be given the choice to invent, craft and create cards that satisfy the goal of surviving each age until you have built your way to victory.

Building the path for victory will be completely different each match, with a handful of distinct paths to victory. Science for example is the most traditional for most strategy players with its conditions to be to research your desired decks and build around them.However Religion or Culture (Amongst a few others) gives a complete pivot into a different feel for the game.

A personal favourite being Divinity in Sacrifice, in which you must create a town of as many people as you can to sacrifice at your temples each turn to please the gods to a religious point based victory.

Features

  • 250+ cards to collect

  • 50+ technologies to invent

  • 100+ cultures to learn

  • 50+ religions to pray to

  • 50+ unique ages to play through

  • 1+ Dogs to pet, 1+ Cats to Pstststst

Dynamic City Building

City Building in this game is more akin to building up huge potent combos based on the win condition you form over the course of the game, with each building or unit having some synergy with another and over a hundred unique cards to create (each having over a dozen culture upgrades to stack), city management plays a huge role in gameplay.

  • Place Cards each with adjacency or District bonus together to form novel combos that make your city stronger each turn, whilst given complete player freedom about building wide, tall, or strategies such as stacking all your power into one card (we all know at least one min-maxer)

  • Build new cards with the intuitive stacking mechanic, placing cards onto other cards will immediately build you new ones, allowing you to pivot quickly or double down on existing ideas for your city; provided your leadership skills does not cause your people to starve and revolt when using the last of the food to build a shiny new Claypit

Fun fact, almost a side note; but in a single district (of which you can build plenty) there are almost 600 million unique combinations of cards that you can configure.

Resource Management

From Barley to Berrys, Slate and Stone, First Age's provides a great variety of loots that are core to the progress of each turn. Each loot found can be used to build new cards, boost existing cards, or to unlock new cards through the technology tree.

  • Explore Dozens of hand crafted maps, each with their own unique cards to find, ancient relics and play styles to match, some maps may give you fruitful start conditions, but lack the materials for the stone building’s you might need for the coming winter, others may throw you into a dessert with a rich dessert nile to feed you for generations

  • Every turn matters, Villagers are limited to very few actions per turn, so risking them on searching through forests over tending a farms for extra food might be costly, player choice takes the helm on your victory

Religion, Faith, Science, Culture

There are many conditions to victory, with 4 being the primary focus of the game, with each core Tree being the hallmark for your win condition, however to pursue them is completely optional.

  • Science- aids you unlock new Buildings to craft, at the expense of loot you gather from the wild, or craft from your buildings

  • Gold- allows you to buy out cards you might be lacking, or desire, however comes at the expense of dedicating resources to gathering the traders currency

  • Culture- gifts you with create arts, allowing you to place upgrades onto any of your cards that you own, completely changing how any one card behaves

  • Religion- faith of the gods will grant you powerful bonuses, but only when you satisfy the deity you pray to, this style completely changes how you might play the game drastically, be it harvest festivals or human sacrifice 

The Ages

With these great bonuses comes a greater difficulty, Ages; After you have run out of turns, you must pick a new age. Each new age will force the tests of time our ancestors once endured onto you, with the next following turns giving you an increasingly more difficult scenario to overcome.

  • Each age gives you a challenge, and reward for completing, some may be as simple as celebrating the winter solstice, whereas others may be surviving great plagues, ice age’s or droughts, the world of ancient humanity was tough, and we aim to reflect that fantasy

  • With over 30 ages to experience, and dozens you can unlock and discover there will always be something interesting to engage with even as an experienced strategy veteran

This game is a complete passion project by One Developer Please reach out to me and share your opinions, ideas and feedback - i am eagerly listening

short_description: Build, Experiment, and guide humanities first steps. First Age is a card based strategy game set in the Neolithic Age of Man. Invent new Cards, Manage your tribe and construct powerful decks as you lead your people whichever way you deem fit. will your civilisation stand the test of time?
